event.text: Does your acne tend to worsen around the time of your period, or has the severity stayed fairly constant throughout your cycle?
event.why: Jawline acne with poor OTC response often relates to hormonal patterns, which would affect whether topical therapy alone or systemic options including hormonal approaches are most appropriate.

event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review in this message thread, with a same-day service-hours target, to discuss prescription options for acne that hasn't responded to over-the-counter products. Photos of the affected areas and a list of what you've already tried will help. If you develop painful deep lumps, rapidly spreading or scarring lesions, or fever with the skin changes, seek in-person care promptly rather than waiting for a message reply.
